entities.name: Dorath Pinto Uchôa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dorath Pinto Uchôa was a Brazilian archaeologist and one of the founders of Brazilian Society of Archaeology. She specialized in the study of prehistoric coastal human settlements with a special emphasis on the study of prehistoric middens in the State of São Paulo, Brazil.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dorath Pinto Uchôa was a Brazilian archaeologist and one of the founders of Brazilian Society of Archaeology. She specialized in the study of prehistoric coastal human settlements with a special emphasis on the study of prehistoric middens in the State of São Paulo, Brazil.
